$comment: Pocket Realm Windows native dependency manifest (Phase 2c of the
Windows port). Consumed by scripts/build_win_deps.py with the vcpkg
toolchain pinned at VCPKG_COMMIT below; versions mirror the Android
Boost 1.86.0) so both platforms compile against the same dependency
generation. Triplet: x64-windows-static (static libs + static /MT CRT,
matching Boost_USE_STATIC_RUNTIME=ON in the Android build).
sqlite3 is deliberately NOT here: the repo pins the 3.46.1 amalgamation
the MSVC lane compiles that exact source, same as the Android sqlite
name: pocketrealm-win-deps
